POST /v1/analytics/events.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.event_date AS bucket, e.platform AS g1, countIf(e.event = 'bond_deal') AS deals, uniqExactIf(e.one_id_uint, e.event = 'bond_deal') AS deal_users, uniqExact(e.one_id_uint) AS _k FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'sinopac_demo' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('bond_deal') GROUP BY bucket, g1) SELECT bucket, g1, deals, deal_users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT base.bucket, base.g1, if(base._k < 20, NULL, base.deals) AS deals, if(base._k < 20, NULL, base.deal_users) AS deal_users, base._k AS _k FROM base) ORDER BY bucket, g1

POST /v1/analytics/funnel.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.one_id, windowFunnel(604800)(toDateTime(e.time), (e.event = 'hq_stockdetail_view'), (e.event = 'bond_order'), (e.event = 'bond_deal')) AS level FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'sinopac_demo' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event IN ('bond_deal', 'bond_order', 'hq_stockdetail_view') GROUP BY e.one_id HAVING level > 0) SELECT step, if(_k < 20, NULL, users) AS users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT step, uniqExactIf(one_id, level >= step) AS users, uniqExactIf(one_id, level >= step) AS _k FROM base ARRAY JOIN range(1, 4) AS step GROUP BY step) ORDER BY step

POST /v1/analytics/retention.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, toMonday(toDate(e.time, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS cohort FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'sinopac_demo' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-20') AND toDate('2026-10-16') AND e.event = 'app_login_success' AND (e.event = 'app_login_success') GROUP BY one_id, cohort), r AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, toMonday(toDate(e.time, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS rb FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'sinopac_demo' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-09-20') AND toDate('2026-11-13') AND e.event = 'app_login_success' AND (e.event = 'app_login_success') GROUP BY one_id, rb), u AS (SELECT c.one_id AS one_id, c.cohort AS cohort, groupArrayIf(dateDiff('week', c.cohort, r.rb), r.rb >= c.cohort AND dateDiff('week', c.cohort, r.rb) <= 3) AS periods FROM c LEFT JOIN r ON c.one_id = r.one_id GROUP BY c.one_id, c.cohort) SELECT cohort, period, users, if(users < 20, NULL, retained) AS retained, if(users < 20, NULL, retained / users) AS rate, users < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT cohort, period, uniqExact(one_id) AS users, uniqExactIf(one_id, arrayExists(p -> p >= 1 AND p <= period, periods)) AS retained FROM u ARRAY JOIN range(1, 4) AS period GROUP BY cohort, period) ORDER BY cohort, period

POST /v1/analytics/path.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.one_id AS one_id, e.time AS time, e.event_id AS event_id, e.session_id AS session_id, multiIf(e.event = '$AppEnd', '離開', e.event) AS node, (node = 'app_login_success') AS is_anchor FROM dmp.events AS e WHERE e.project = 'sinopac_demo' AND e.event_date BETWEEN toDate('2026-10-01') AND toDate('2026-10-16')), p AS (SELECT *, dateDiff('second', lagInFrame(time, 1, time) OVER (PARTITION BY one_id ORDER BY time, event_id), time) > 1800 AS brk FROM ev), sq AS (SELECT one_id, time, event_id, node, is_anchor, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY one_id ORDER BY time, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sid FROM p), s AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arraySlice(arraySort(x -> (x.1, x.4), groupArray((time, node, is_anchor, event_id))), 1, 200) AS seq FROM sq GROUP BY one_id, sid), m AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arrayFilter((x, i) -> i = 1 OR x.2 != seq[i - 1].2, seq, arrayEnumerate(seq)) AS seq2 FROM s), x AS (SELECT one_id, sid, if(seq2[-1].2 = '離開', seq2, arrayPushBack(seq2, (seq2[-1].1, '離開', 0, seq2[-1].4))) AS seq3 FROM m), r AS (SELECT one_id, sid, arrayMap(y -> y.2, sl) AS path, dateDiff('millisecond', sl[1].1, sl[-1].1) AS dur FROM (SELECT one_id, sid, arraySlice(seq3, idx, 4) AS sl FROM x ARRAY JOIN arrayEnumerate(seq3) AS idx WHERE seq3[idx].3)) SELECT path, if(_k < 20, NULL, _k) AS users, if(_k < 20, NULL, _n) AS sessions, if(_k < 20, NULL, _ms) AS avg_ms, anchor_users, _k, _k < 20 AS suppressed FROM (SELECT path, uniqExact(one_id) AS _k, count() AS _n, avg(dur) AS _ms, (SELECT uniqExact(one_id) FROM r) AS anchor_users FROM r GROUP BY path) ORDER BY _k DESC, _n DESC, path LIMIT 100
